home.desc1: With just a paragraph of text, AiMe can automatically build a parallel world with millions of Agents based on real-world seeds. Inject variables from a god's-eye view, find the optimal solution in complex group interactions.
home.slogan: Let the future be rehearsed in Agent swarms, let decisions win after a hundred battles
home.readyDesc: Prediction engine on standby, upload multiple unstructured data to initialize simulation sequence
home.highAvailDesc: Simulate up to millions of Agents
home.step1Desc: Real seed extraction & individual/group memory injection & GraphRAG construction
home.step2Desc: Entity relation extraction & persona generation & configure Agent simulation parameters
home.step3Desc: Dual-platform parallel simulation & auto-parse prediction requirements & dynamic sequential memory update
home.step4Desc: ReportAgent has a rich toolset for deep interaction with the post-simulation environment
home.step5Desc: Chat with anyone in the simulated world & chat with ReportAgent
home.uploadHint: or click to browse file system
